# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** Student at Wexcombe College  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida possesses a striking, uneven, and captivating beauty. She has smooth hair resembling brown nuts, plump cheeks with a warm flush, curiously angled black eyebrows, large dark plush eyes, and uneven rose-colored lips. She dresses stylishly in elegant outfits and high-quality hats.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## Personality

Cressida is charming, affectionate, deeply loyal, and free of snobbery. Though she appears foolish and lively on the outside, she possesses a great deal of intellect and self-awareness. She is highly popular, admitting to being indecisive and unable to keep secrets, while genuinely treating her numerous suitors as companions.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

## Traits

- Loyal  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Indecisive  <sub>[v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026)</sub>
- Incapable of keeping secrets  <sub>[v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036)</sub>
- Intellectual  <sub>[v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>
- Friendly and outgoing  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P24](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0024)</sub>

## Abilities

- Skillful in sweeping floors and washing dishes  <sub>[v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066)</sub>

## Goals

- To be well-liked and enjoy college life  <sub>[v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)</sub>
- To become a superior, wiser, and stouter-hearted person inspired by Nell  <sub>[v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>

## History

Cressida met Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis at a cemetery in Portmaris while attending Wexcombe College. She introduced herself enthusiastically, shared details of her background, and quickly formed a tight bond with them. As an elite and popular freshman at Wexcombe, she easily gained entry into clubs and social cliques, bringing Nell and Honora into her wide circle of acquaintances. Despite her popularity among male suitors, she expressed a fond admiration for Hugh Carrow—who treated her like a kitten—and admitted her deep affectionate envy of Nell's influence on her own aspirations. Later, she visited and shared domestic tasks alongside her friends, including attempting to handle household affairs.

_Sources: [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005), [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a wealthy, prominent man of elite Bluenose lineage from Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> If you merely take Cressida Lindsay as God created her, despite her shortcomings, I think you will grow fond of her in time.  <sub>[v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062)</sub>

> Queen Nell, I hold a grievance against you. Truthfully, hating you is what I should be doing, yet I adore you passionately instead, and failing to behold you daily leaves me wretched.  <sub>[v3 c5 P5](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0005)</sub>

> Everyone has become accustomed to one another. Also, cleaning dishes and sweeping floors are skills I have acquired.  <sub>[v3 c16 P66](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0066)</sub>


## Affiliations

- Wexcombe College — Freshman student  <sub>[v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
